levels.name: local_deterministic_repair
levels.trigger: serialization wrapper or derived bookkeeping defect with unchanged creative bytes
levels.action: normalize wrapper or recompute local metadata
levels.freeze: all creative and unrelated frozen artifacts remain fixed
levels.state_change_proof: target derived hash changes and finding set shrinks

levels.name: single_field_or_artifact_patch
levels.trigger: exact title or narrative finding local to one event
levels.action: patch only named candidate field; preserve other field and every unrelated artifact
levels.escalation: L2 when dependency hint requires predecessor
levels.state_change_proof: target payload changes, exact finding removed, no unrelated hash change

levels.name: dependency_closure_patch
levels.trigger: finding closure is current event plus at most immediate predecessor
levels.action: patch proven closure of at most two event artifacts
levels.state_change_proof: closure receipt changes, issue set monotonically shrinks, outside hashes exact

levels.name: slice1_set_regeneration
levels.action: regenerate only Slice1 event-realization set from unchanged authority
levels.state_change_proof: new set payload hash and reduced issue signature

no_progress_signature: sha256(parent authority + candidate payload + canonical finding set + closure ids)
same_failure_rule: if signature repeats without target or issue-set change, stop immediately; no dispatch/retry
